case_factors.description: Concise serialized case factors: violated articles, dominant violation, metadata, external factors, applicant structure, and visible harm cues.

zero_award_assessment.description: Visible serialized reasons for or against 0 EUR; do not infer no-claim or Article 41 defects from absent fields.

damages_assessment.description: Concise assessment of non-pecuniary harm gravity using only serialized strict features.

applicant_aggregation.description: How the single case-level total handles applicants or joined applications without per-applicant multiplication.

amount_calibration.description: Concrete EUR band in the form X-Y EUR and selected point; if zero, use 0-0 EUR; select 0 EUR.

final_award_reasoning.description: One short paragraph explaining why the chosen original-scale EUR amount is calibrated.

award_eur.description: Original-scale case-level EUR amount. Use exactly 0 when the calibrated amount is zero; otherwise use an integer of at least 500 EUR.
